engineeringSkip.reason: No human pheromone has ever been conclusively identified or linked to a specific emotional response, so 'engineered pheromones' that trigger targeted feelings are an unsupported consumer-product claim rather than an engineering pathway grounded in known biology.

factCheck.reason: There is no established evidence that humans respond to pheromones strongly enough to be steered, so the idea that synthetic ones could be engineered to trigger chosen emotions in other people is a marketing claim rather than a real technology.
